probe_results_on__padLoadActInfo_rcv.verdict: THE MECHANISM WORKS AND DELIVERS EXACTLY THE PREDICTED SHAPE, BUT COSTS 14 DIFFS NET. Do not wire it for this fn today.

corrections_to_the_in_source_receipt: The in-source claim 'cc1 emits the UNSPLIT macro forms `sw $2,_actcur` / `la $7,_actcur` in the .s, then ... splits them itself' is WRONG about WHO splits and WHO fills. Reading build/recon/syslib/psx/libpad/PADCMD.c.s: cc1 (the 970404 rung) emits the SPLIT pair `lui $2,%hi(_actcur) # high` / `sw $3,%lo(_actcur)($2)` directly, and cc1's OWN reorg puts the halves in the delay slots inside its OWN `.set noreorder / .set nomacro` blocks. GNU as never sees a macro to split, so this is NOT the W51 AT-MACRO-SPLIT assembler class and no assembler-side mechanism (maspsx reorder option, .set noreorder fence) can reach it.
Consequently the residual is a RUNG-BASIN CONFLICT, not a missing mechanism: the fn needs 970404's BODY basin AND 2.8's address-split suppression, and no single rung offers both.

named_next_angle_for__padLoadActInfo_rcv.claim: NOT a floor. The 2.8.x + -mno-split-addresses basin is the ONLY count-exact basin found (157/157) and is therefore the structurally correct one under the floor bar.
named_next_angle_for__padLoadActInfo_rcv.why_it_scores_28_there: all three source devices currently in the fn were derived and tuned IN THE 970404 BASIN across w61/w62 -- the shared-exit ownership goto pair, the zero-trip-guarded `ac = &_actcur` anchor, and the two opacity fences. The 28-diff residual in the 2.8 basin is dominated by exactly those devices misfiring: `bnez v0` vs `beqz v0` + `j T` vs `jr ra` (shared-exit ownership on the wrong site for this basin) and `addu t0,v0,zero` vs `li t0,-1` (the zero-trip-guard anchor device not firing).
named_next_angle_for__padLoadActInfo_rcv.work_item: re-derive the three devices INSIDE the 2.8.0+nosplit basin (04Z basin-relativity), carried by this mechanism as a per-fn splice so the rest of the TU keeps the 970404 rung. Estimated reachable: count-exact 157/157 is already in hand; the residual is device re-tuning, not an identity.

recommendation: IMPLEMENT the mechanism (it is a genuine capability gap, ~25 lines, strictly generalising), but WIRE NOTHING with it yet. It is the prerequisite for the _padLoadActInfo_rcv work item above and for any future (rung x flag) identity on a 2.6/2.7-wired TU.
